question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a teal present, Bob has a purple present, Claire has a blue present, Dave has a pink present, Eve has a white present, Fred has a grey present, and Gertrude has a gold present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Dave and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Gertrude and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Bob and Dave swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Gertrude swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Fred has the
Options:
(A) teal present
(B) purple present
(C) blue present
(D) pink present
(E) white present
(F) grey present
(G) gold present
solution:
Gift colors in order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: teal, purple, blue, pink, white, grey, gold
1. Dave ↔ Gertrude: teal, purple, blue, gold, white, grey, pink
2. Gertrude ↔ Dave: teal, purple, blue, pink, white, grey, gold
3. Bob ↔ Dave: teal, pink, blue, purple, white, grey, gold
4. Eve ↔ Bob: teal, white, blue, purple, pink, grey, gold
5. Eve ↔ Gertrude: teal, white, blue, purple, gold, grey, pink
6. Eve ↔ Bob: teal, gold, blue, purple, white, grey, pink
7. Alice ↔ Claire: blue, gold, teal, purple, white, grey, pink
Fred has the grey present, option (F).
Final answer: (F)
